summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting a SELL 3438 / BUY 687 pair that is cancelled together and re-posted one tick lower as the touch fell from 9999/10001 to 9992/9994. The SELL quotes executed 9229 in total. There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution, so there was no benefit. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.43x). Closure standard met: market making supported, features (a) and (b) absent. Caveat: the sizes are asymmetric (3438 vs 687), cancel_symmetry is 0.36 and the trader's SELL notional is 5x its BUY, but cancels are simultaneous on both sides and the price moved against the sells.

The alert was triggered by the registered SYN.A market maker's two-sided 2996-lot quotes, which were cancelled and re-posted every 2-3 s. It was also triggered by one 28280-lot BUY order (O-00017597, 11.7x depth). That order was working before the trader's only opposite-side trade. 15016 lots (53.1%) were executed on it before the 499-lot SELL at 12:39:14.737. There was no favourable price move and no reversion. Feature (a), an order not intended to execute, is absent. Feature (b), a benefit from an opposite-side execution, is absent. Genuine execution of the resting order is supported.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM desk) quoting a bid and an ask of its typical size 2467 at the touch, and cancelling and re-quoting both together about every 2 s. Cancels are symmetric (0.98). No single order reaches 3x depth (peak 1.02x). Both sides were filled, with same-side fills of 3156 on its own quotes. Round trip is +0.11 ticks, which is ordinary spread income. The detector fired on the gross quote refresh volume, not on one-sided displayed size.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoted two-sided at 2880 for about 40s, which is ordinary market making. At 14:52:13.106 the quoting stopped and a single BUY of 24122 (10.0x depth) was placed at 9996, 3 ticks off the touch, with nothing resting on the other side. 1.8s later the trader sold 1200 at market, hitting bids at 9999 to 9997. The large BUY was cancelled 422ms after that sale with 0 executed. The price then reverted 2 ticks. The market-making explanation covers the quotes but not this order. Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is plausible but not clear, because the sale was at falling prices. The evidence is mixed, so I am escalating to Level 2.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM desk) re-quoting a 3124 SELL / 624 BUY pair about every 3s. The detector fired on gross sell size and a 624 BUY fill at 12:25:05. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.30x). The sell quotes were executing: 3272 filled before the BUY fill, and 11050 in total. The BUY fill came with no reversion, and the round trip was negative. Closure standard met: explanation supported, features (a) and (b) absent.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoted two-sided at 2485 (its typical size) with high churn for about 80s, which is ordinary market making. At 10:58:19.353 it then placed a one-sided SELL of 18864 (7.83x depth) at 9999, 2 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the bid. At 10:58:21.157 it bought 1035 by market order, and cancelled the whole SELL 140 ms later with no fills. Discriminators show a price move of +1.0 tick and a reversion of 1.0 tick on this order. The market-making explanation does not account for this order, so I propose escalation to Level 2. Repetition is 1, so I am not proposing a STOR draft.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size of 2138 (about 0.89x depth), re-quoting every 2-3 s with paired bid/ask cancels. Cancels are symmetric (0.96). No single order reached 3x depth. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

Detector fired on repeated two-sided 3164-lot quotes (about 1.3x depth) from a registered market maker, plus one SELL of 31515 (13.1x depth) placed at the touch at 15:57:10. That large order was working: 14691 (46.6%) executed against it before the trader's only opposite-side trade (a 527 BUY at 15:57:19). The remainder was cancelled 3.98s later. Under section 6.2 this is genuine execution of the resting order, so feature (a) is absent. The small opposite trade while the order was working is ordinary order management, so feature (b) is absent. The quotes are symmetric, with no event, risk or repetition pattern. The evidence is not clean: price_move_ticks is +1.0 with 0.5 reversion on the large order. I judge that insufficient for feature (b) given the order's own fill record.

Registered SYN.A market maker (typical size 3550) quoted two-sided with symmetric re-quotes for about 40s; that part is ordinary market making. The evidence is mixed, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2.

The detector fired on the trader's 2848-lot two-sided quote refresh and on one large BUY, O-00018812. Registered ETF-MM market maker on SYN.A. The quotes are symmetric and sized at the desk's typical size, so they are ordinary market making. The only order of at least 3x depth is O-00018812 (28290, 11.1x depth, 1 tick from the touch). 13632 of it (48%) executed BEFORE the trader's single small opposite-side SELL of 474. That makes it a working order, so feature (a) is absent. The 474 sell while the order was working, and the later cancel of the 14658 remainder, are ordinary order management under section 6.2. Feature (b) is not established. No news or risk event, no prior alerts. Residual doubt: the order's own price_move_ticks is +1 with reversion 1, and the order is 11x depth.

The detector triggers come from registered-MM two-sided quoting (typical size 2917, symmetric cancels), which is a supported explanation for those quotes. But at 14:07:37 the trader placed a single one-sided SELL of 29128 (11.4x depth) at 10004, 2 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the other side. A market BUY of 1215 followed 2.5s later and swept 10002-10004. The SELL was cancelled 125ms after that BUY, with zero fills. Market making does not account for this order. No favourable price move or reversion is shown, so feature (b) is not demonstrated, and the BUY partly swept the trader's own price level. The evidence is mixed, so I propose escalation to Level 2. A STOR draft is not supported: one cycle only and no benefit shown.

No market event, no risk event, no prior alerts. The explanation is genuine execution of the resting order. Market making accounts for the quotes, not for the large order, so I do not rely on it for that order.

Registered market maker on SYN.A (ETF-MM desk) quoting both sides at its typical size of 2640 and re-quoting every 2-3 s.
